title: Suricata - security
description: IDS alerts, threat hunting heuristics and sensor health from the 'suricata' stream

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1'))

SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) AND alert_severity = 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT alert_signature_id) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1'))

SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') THEN src_ip ELSE dest_ip END) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1'))

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, concat('sev ', CAST(alert_severity AS VARCHAR)) AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT alert_category AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Top signatures
panels.description: Noisy signature? Add its SID to services.suricata.disabledRules

queries.query: SELECT alert_severity AS x_axis_1, alert_signature AS x_axis_2, alert_category AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2, count(DISTINCT dest_ip) AS y_axis_3, max(to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp)) AS y_axis_4 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC, y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Latest alerts
panels.description: Search the community ID in the logs view to get every event of that connection

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, alert_severity AS x_axis_2, alert_signature AS x_axis_3, src_ip AS x_axis_4, src_port AS x_axis_5, dest_ip AS x_axis_6, dest_port AS x_axis_7, app_proto AS x_axis_8, alert_signature_id AS x_axis_9, community_id AS x_axis_10 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT dest_ip AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert' AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Port scan / sweep candidates
panels.description: Sources touching many ports (vertical scan) or many hosts (horizontal sweep)

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, count(DISTINCT dest_port) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT dest_ip) AS y_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_3, sum(CASE WHEN proto = 'TCP' AND flow_pkts_toclient = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS y_axis_4 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '224.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '239.%' OR dest_ip = '255.255.255.255' OR dest_ip LIKE '%.255' OR dest_ip LIKE 'ff0%' OR dest_ip LIKE '169.254.%') AND NOT ((src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1')) GROUP BY x_axis_1 HAVING count(DISTINCT dest_port) > 20 OR count(DISTINCT dest_ip) > 30 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Unanswered TCP connections
panels.description: The other side never answered: filtered ports, dead services or scans

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, dest_port AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND proto = 'TCP' AND flow_pkts_toclient = 0 GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Large uploads to the internet
panels.description: More than 50 MB sent to one public address in the time range

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, dest_port AS x_axis_3, sum(flow_bytes_toserver) AS y_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 HAVING sum(flow_bytes_toserver) > 50000000 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Unusual outbound ports
panels.description: Extend COMMON_PORTS in generate.py with what is normal for you

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, proto AS x_axis_2, dest_port AS x_axis_3, app_proto AS x_axis_4, count(DISTINCT dest_ip) AS y_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') AND dest_port NOT IN (22, 53, 80, 123, 443, 853, 993, 465, 587, 3478, 5349, 51820) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3, x_axis_4 ORDER BY y_axis_2 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Beaconing candidates
panels.description: Many small, regular connections to one endpoint. Use 24h+. Expect NTP and update checks

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, dest_port AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp))) AS y_axis_2, avg((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_3 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 HAVING count(*) >= 24 AND avg((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) < 20000 AND count(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp))) >= 6 ORDER BY y_axis_2 DESC, y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: DNS bypassing adguard
panels.description: Clients resolving through something other than adguard (adguard's own upstream traffic is excluded)

queries.query: SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, dest_port AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (app_proto = 'dns' OR dest_port IN (53, 853)) AND dest_ip NOT IN ('192.168.0.10') AND src_ip NOT IN ('192.168.0.10') AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Suspicious domain names
panels.description: Very long names or long random-looking labels: DNS tunnelling, DGAs (and CDNs)

queries.query: SELECT dns_rrname AS x_axis_1, src_ip AS x_axis_2, length(dns_rrname) AS y_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'request' AND (length(dns_rrname) > 60 OR regexp_like(dns_rrname, '[a-z0-9]{25,}')) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, tls_sni AS x_axis_3, tls_version AS x_axis_4, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'tls' AND tls_version IN ('SSLv2', 'SSLv3', 'TLS 1.0', 'TLS 1.1') GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3, x_axis_4 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Protocol anomalies
panels.description: Malformed or unexpected protocol behaviour detected by the decoders

queries.query: SELECT anomaly_type AS x_axis_1, anomaly_event AS x_axis_2, app_proto AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'anomaly' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, count(DISTINCT dest_port) AS y_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND NOT (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Kernel drop rate
panels.description: Packets the kernel dropped before suricata saw them, since suricata started

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN max(stats_capture_kernel_packets) > 0 THEN 100.0 * max(stats_capture_kernel_drops) / max(stats_capture_kernel_packets) ELSE 0 END AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats'
SELECT max(stats_uptime) / 3600.0 AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats'
SELECT max(stats_flow_active) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats'

panels.title: Stats events
panels.description: One per minute when the sensor is healthy

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats'
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, max(stats_capture_kernel_drops) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, event_type AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, max(stats_flow_active) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Memcap / queue problems
panels.description: Should stay at 0. If it grows, suricata needs more memory

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, max(coalesce(stats_flow_memcap, 0) + coalesce(stats_tcp_ssn_memcap_drop, 0) + coalesce(stats_detect_alert_queue_overflow, 0)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'stats' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
